A_target.statement: Every [[Definition:Boolean Function|Boolean function]] $f: \set {0, 1}^n \to \set {0, 1}$ with $n \ge 1$ is expressed by a formula using only the [[Definition:Logical NAND|NAND]] connective $\uparrow$.

B_source.statement: Every Boolean function is expressed by a formula in [[Definition:Disjunctive Normal Form|disjunctive normal form]], using only $\land$, $\lor$ and $\neg$.

object_map.reformulation: Express the three connectives of disjunctive normal form by NAND and substitute.

validity_conditions: The substitution is recursive, so it applies to arbitrarily nested formulas.
The constant functions are expressible since p NAND (p NAND p) is a tautology.
proof_plan: By [[De Morgan's Laws (Logic)|De Morgan's laws]], $p \lor q \equiv \neg p \uparrow \neg q \equiv \paren {p \uparrow p} \uparrow \paren {q \uparrow q}$.
